{{Quote|The first surprise the belt had in store, however, was the discovery of strange patterns of ancient runes we found etched into the sides of several asteroids while performing a routine topographical scan of grid sector 867-3A4.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD" />}}
'''Grid sector 867-3A4''' was a part of the [[Serianan Belt]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]]. It contained several [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] with [[Serianan runes|ancient runes]] carved on their surfaces, including [[Unidentified Serianan Belt asteroid|one]] that also housed the artificial [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] known as [[the Gulch]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] ''[[Jedi Dreamer]]'' explored the area.

==Description==
Grid sector 867-3A4 was an area of the [[Serianan Belt]], a [[Asteroid field/Legends|field]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] situated in<ref name="SD" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]]. It contained several of the belt's larger asteroids, and the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] body with the largest size in the sector was an [[Unidentified Serianan Belt asteroid|asteroid]] that hosted the artificial [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] known as [[the Gulch]].<ref name="SD" />

==History==
{{Quote|While the whole field of asteroids deserves to be studied in detail, several of the larger specimens, particularly in grid sector 867-3A4, have gained the most attention.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD" />}}
[[File:Serianan_Belt.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The scout starship ''Jedi Dreamer'' explored grid sector 867-3A4.]]
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]] [[Scout ship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Jedi Dreamer]]'' under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Korren Starchaser]] undertook an [[Serias expedition|expedition]] to the Serianan [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Eventually, while performing a routine topographical scan of grid sector 867-3A4, the crew of the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] discovered the [[Serianan runes|ancient runes]] that were carved on several of the Serianan Belt's asteroids. In addition, the scouts subsequently found the Gulch, which they explored using [[Vagabond suit|Vagabond]] [[Environment suit/Legends|deep space powersuits]], and recovered from it a set of five [[Serianan statue|alien statues]].<ref name="SD" />

Starchaser, wishing to protect the Serianan system from an ill-[[Time/Legends|timed]] discovery by "unsavory" interests, ultimately cut the expedition short. In a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] report he made on the expedition, the scout captain noted that several of grid sector 867-3A4's asteroids were particularly worthy of further studies and, in a diagram attached to the document, noted the most prominent runes discovered in the area as well as their relative locations.<ref name="SD" />

{{RPGseed}}
Later, the New Republic Scout Service hired a group of individuals to carry out a follow-up investigation of the Serianan Belt, primarily focusing on studying the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] composition of the Gulch.<ref name="SD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Locations==
{{Quote|The Gulch is the nickname we gave to an immense cavern inside the largest, most heavily carved asteroid in sector 867-3A4.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD" />}}
Multiple asteroids of grid sector 867-3A4 featured patterns of ancient runes carved on their surfaces, with the asteroid housing the Gulch having the highest concentration of such markings.<ref name="SD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grid sector 867-3A4 was introduced in the "[[Scouts' Dispatch]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, published in [[November]] [[1995]]. The feature was written by [[Peter Woodworth]], illustrated by [[David R. Deitrick|David Deitrick]], and included a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure seed related to the Gulch that this article assumes plays out as described.<ref name="SD" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Serianan system, and thereby grid sector 867-3A4, in grid square P-2.<ref name="TEA" />
